moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio momentum-drift, written here): Card flicked by a cursor: x 0 → 168 px at 598 ms (power2.out) → 184 at 739 ms (sine.out, drifting past) → 175 at 880 ms (power2.inOut) (demo ×1.03); three speed lines behind it scale with speed.
